newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers in anticancer research pact.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers in anticancer research pact.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Monday it signed a 3-year reseach pact with Germany's national research center for biotechnology to develop a new class of microbial anti-cancer compounds.
The company said the epothilone compounds, which are secreted by strains of certain bacteria, kill tumor cells by preventing cell division.

Under the agreement, Bristol-Myers will have the exclusive rights to the production strains, know-how and epothilone chemistry developed by Germany's Gesellschaft fur Biotechnologische Forschung mbH, which employs about 600 scientists and technical staff.
The company said it will provide the research center with undisclosed upfront and milestone payments, research funding and royalties from any marketed compounds in return.
